summaryZh: 荷兰百合种植企业Veninga Hijken Bloembollen BV自7月起每晚使用西班牙Agrikola公司的Wagus机器人，在3个预编程百合苗床上自动行驶，通过向下照射的UV-C灯在灰霉病菌孢子侵入百合植株前将其杀灭，以UV光处理替代杀菌剂喷洒。该案例展示了自动化机器人+UV-C物理植保技术在花卉种植中的实际应用，对智慧农业精准植保具有参考价值。
featuredReason: 该案例展示了自主机器人搭载UV-C物理杀菌技术替代化学农药的落地实践，对智慧畜牧/种植领域的精准植保、自动化装备应用及减药增效具有直接借鉴意义。
contentFull:
UV-C light in the fight against botrytis in lilies

 12-10 | Smart farming | Article

LinkedInFacebookXWhatsAppPrint

Photos: Koos Groenewold

On one of the lily fields belonging to Veninga Hijken Bloembollen BV, a small implement has been waking up every evening since July as soon as darkness falls. It is the Wagus from Spanish manufacturer Agrikola. The machine is equipped with downward-facing UV-C lamps and drives over 3 pre-programmed lily beds. The aim: to use UV light to destroy botrytis spores just before they enter the lily plant at the next location. In this way, treatment with UV light is an alternative to spraying fungicides
